notes:
Denomination confirmed 2026-09-10 from the two official LCMS listings: Lutheran Church-Missouri Synod, English District, V-Circuit / Arizona South. The placeholder wording in the seed record was already right and is now verified rather than assumed.

Address: 1220 W Magee Rd, Tucson AZ 85704 is the WORSHIP location - both LCMS listings state that Messiah worships at Ascension Lutheran Church, 1220 W Magee Rd. Messiah's own mailing address is PO Box 262, Cortaro, AZ 85652-0262, which is a post office box and must not be plotted. Coordinates were already verified for the Magee Rd building and were left unchanged. Note for the map: Ascension Lutheran Church + School (ascensiontucson.org) is a separate LCMS congregation at the same address; Messiah is the tenant, so the two churches will share a map pin.

Pastor: the Rev. Luther P. Esala, listed by the LCMS locator as Sole Pastor and by the English District as the pastor (lpesala@msn.com). No associate or assisting pastor is listed. Worship Sundays at 9:30am, Sunday School 10:45am.

Still missing: the congregation has no website of its own. Searches on 2026-09-10 found no YouTube channel, Facebook page, podcast or SermonAudio account for Messiah Lutheran Church Tucson - note that generic searches pull up other congregations named Messiah Lutheran (messiahlutheran.com, messiahlc.org) that are not this church. With no published sermons this record is not reviewable; a phone call (520-401-7849) would be needed to find out whether sermons or manuscripts are shared anywhere.
